ver: Artifact-level version counter. Incremented every time a screen tech-spec is written (one increment per screen).
meta.title: Application name, copied from PRD meta.title.
meta.updated_at: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last write.
endpoints: Flat index of all API endpoints across the project. Built incrementally — each run of 2-screen replaces all entries for that screen. For non-API systems, this will be an empty array.
endpoints[].path: API path — e.g. '/api/orders', '/api/orders/:id/cancel'. Must follow shared-decisions naming_conventions.api_endpoints.
endpoints[].description: One-line description of what this endpoint does.
endpoints[].screen_id: Screen ID this endpoint belongs to — matches screen-index. Used to replace entries when a screen is re-processed.
endpoints[].usecase_id: Usecase ID this endpoint implements — matches usecase-index.
endpoints[].auth_required: true if this endpoint requires authentication; false for public endpoints.
endpoints[].actor_ids: List of actor IDs (from actor-index) who can call this endpoint.
